children: Consolidated Water, via subsidiary PERC Water, entered into a fixed-price $39.8 million design-build agreement with the City of Pismo Beach to deliver the Central Coast Blue Advanced Water Purification Facility in Grover Beach, California. The contract covers design, procurement, construction, commissioning and training, with Substantial Completion targeted within 703 days, around Sep 17, 2028. The facility is designed to produce approximately 500 acre-feet per year initially, with provisions for future expansion not included in this scope. The agreement includes performance guarantees and liquidated damages of $2,500 per day for delays, capped at about 5% of the contract price.
